steps: Isolate all faulted transmission lines and substations.
Startup local black-start-capable combustion turbine generator.
Energize auxiliary substation transformer and local buses.
Gradually re-energize clean transmission lines, verifying voltage profiles.
Perform cold load pickup in small increments (max 10% of generator capacity) to avoid transient frequency dip.
Detect fault zone and verify breaker trip telemetry.
Send open commands to isolates switches on line terminals.
Perform safety validation checks (voltage/thermal overload constraints).
Close tie-breakers to restore power to un-faulted segments.
Notify operator and trigger field maintenance ticket.
